attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Promote a bounded-depth Res(XOR) lower bound to unrestricted dag-like size.
attacks.method: Audit whether the cited result removes the depth restriction or only proves hardness below a stated depth threshold.
attacks.notes: No valid unrestricted transfer was found.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Choose a mixed family that still has a short linear-algebraic refutation.
attacks.method: Reject pure XOR/Tseitin candidates and require the H062 non-affine residual to survive all Gaussian consequences. A polynomial Res(XOR) proof for the eventual M_n would destroy H064.
attacks.notes: The family must be designed jointly with the proof-system lower-bound measure.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Treat the hard-DNF candidate as an equivalent-to-one circuit without proving tautologicity.
attacks.method: Make H026 an explicit premise. A single falsifying assignment invalidates the circuit equivalence and destroys the corresponding length.
attacks.notes: H065 cannot advance before the H026 branch is resolved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Simplify a tautological DNF circuit to constant one through a polynomial sequence of local rewrites.
attacks.method: Search for a generic clause-by-clause absorption or proof-to-rewrite conversion. Such a construction would amount to a short proof of tautologicity in the exact local relation and was not established.
attacks.notes: No universal short chain was found, but the absence of a candidate Lipschitz potential keeps the hypothesis immature.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Require a general polynomial UNSAT certificate to decode a false positive.
attacks.method: Use the Shannon-local certificate language of H060: a false positive can be localized to a circuit inconsistency or a fully assigned false terminal without certifying the original formula unsatisfiable.
attacks.notes: The self-reduction removes the specific coNP-certificate obstruction recorded against H056.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Hide the SAT lower bound inside the avoided-output decoder or assume a polynomial algorithm for a hard range-avoidance class.
attacks.method: Require a total decoder whose validity is checkable for every avoided string and keep the range-avoidance algorithm as a separate premise.
attacks.notes: H066 is only a reduction bridge; it does not claim range avoidance is already in P.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Use negative intermediate values and inclusion-exclusion to evade DNNF compilation.
attacks.method: Observe that H067 does not forbid cancellation; it concludes that cancellation is one of the necessary escape resources. The attack therefore narrows but does not contradict the statement.
attacks.notes: A later descendant should quantify the minimum cancellation magnitude or overlap complexity.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Find a disjoint nonnegative arithmetic gate pattern with no polynomial d-DNNF translation.
attacks.method: Translate disjoint sums to deterministic OR and variable-disjoint products to decomposable AND, preserving the DAG and model semantics gate by gate.
attacks.notes: The remaining formal issue is aligning every H049 certificate with the stated set semantics.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Assume the Extended-Frege canonical pair is complete enough to encode arbitrary SAT-circuit errors.
attacks.method: Check whether the known canonical-pair definitions provide the exact reductions needed for both false-positive and false-negative local certificates.
attacks.notes: No such reduction is currently committed; this is the central new obligation rather than a known theorem.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Lose polynomial balance when translating restriction triples and witnesses into pair instances.
attacks.method: Require canonical padding, polynomial proof encodings, and one pair instance per local certificate rather than an exponential search tree.
attacks.notes: No forced superpolynomial blow-up was identified at the statement level.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Decide P_N by enumerating every polynomial-size circuit, which is superpolynomial in the truth-table length for the intended parameters.
attacks.method: Reject naive enumeration and make succinct universal verification or range avoidance the explicit next gate.
attacks.notes: The compression step is the entire content of H069 and remains unproved.

attacks.targeted_failure_mode: Show that the proposed property is still large and therefore blocked by the classical natural-proofs barrier under pseudorandomness assumptions.
attacks.method: The statement explicitly requires density at most 2^{-N^epsilon}; if achieved, the largeness premise would fail. The attack shifts to whether such sparsity is compatible with polynomial-time decidability and usefulness.
attacks.notes: No contradiction to the exact sparse formulation was found.
